data.one_liner: Bar indicator made of a series of selected and unselected steps.
data.what_it_does: Provides StepProgressIndicator and CircularStepProgressIndicator widgets to display linear or circular step-based progress bars. Allows customizing step colors, gradients, sizes, spacing, rounded edges, and custom widget builders per step.
use_when: You need a linear or circular progress indicator broken down into distinct steps
You want to build multi-step forms or onboarding wizards with visual step progress
avoid_when: You need standard continuous progress bars without individual steps
strengths: Supports both linear (horizontal/vertical) and circular indicators
Extensively customizable with gradients, custom step widgets, custom colors, and rounded edges
data.minimal_example:
StepProgressIndicator(
    totalSteps: 10,
    currentStep: 6,
    selectedColor: Colors.red,
    unselectedColor: Colors.yellow,
)
